synthesis.body: ssl.SSLContext.load_default_certs has a win32 branch that loads the Windows CA and ROOT stores via enum_certificates, filtering on each certificate trust setting, and no darwin branch at all; Linux resolves through OpenSSL default paths. So a corporate root installed by device management works on Windows and Linux but is invisible to Python on macOS. Do not scope a trust fallback as cross-platform work before checking this: the Windows half is usually already done, and the real residual is WSL, which reports linux and does not inherit the Windows certificate store.

title: macOS is the only platform where Python ignores the OS trust store
